response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), tot AS (SELECT SUM(signal_count) AS total_signals FROM grp) SELECT g.telescref, g.signal_count, t.total_signals, CAST(g.signal_count AS REAL) / t.total_signals AS fraction FROM grp g CROSS JOIN tot t WHERE t.total_signals IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC, g.telescref ASC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Total signal count is the sum of counts across all telescope groups, which equals the number of rows in signals (telescref is NOT NULL, so no group is excluded).
Ties in fraction are broken by telescref ascending for deterministic output; the fraction is returned unrounded as a real-number division.
